rule.name: RegexCompiledInLoop
rule.message: String.matches, replaceAll, replaceFirst and Pattern.matches compile their regex on every call, so with a constant pattern in a loop or a stream lambda the same pattern is compiled once per element. Compile it once: private static final Pattern DATED = Pattern.compile(...) and then DATED.matcher(line).matches() or DATED.matcher(line).replaceAll(...). An exception fits a loop that runs a few times, or a pattern that is cheap to compile.
